final_candidates.decision_summary: Eliminates the conserved V3 loop N-glycan motif (N300-N301-T302, HXB2 N332 equivalent) to confer resistance against V3-glycan targeting broad neutralizing antibodies like PGT121 while maintaining viral replication fitness.

Removes the critical V2 apex N-glycan site (N185-T186-S187), enabling escape from V2 apex-directed broadly neutralizing antibodies such as PG9/PG16 while retaining functional envelope trimer assembly.

Disrupts the loop D N-linked glycosylation site (N275-I276-T277, HXB2 N276 equivalent) to confer resistance to CD4 binding site-directed antibodies like VRC01 while preserving basic protein viability.
